ucs.title: [LLM] Play (Balloonfly) ransomware impact stage — .play extension fan-out + ReadMe.txt drop correlated with VSS shadow-copy wipe
ucs.description: Catches the final-stage Play (PlayCrypt / Balloonfly) detonation pattern: rapid creation of files with the `.play` extension and `ReadMe.txt` ransom notes in user/share paths, correlated on-host with vssadmin/wmic/wbadmin shadow-copy and backup-catalog deletion. Both the literal `.play` extension and the per-directory `ReadMe.txt` (not `Readme!.txt`, not `HowToDecrypt.html`) are hardcoded artefacts in Play's encryptor — CISA AA23-352A.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count as play_writes min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.process_path) as writer_processes from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.play" OR Filesystem.file_name="ReadMe.txt") by host Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where play_writes >= 20 | join host type=inner [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as vss_events values(Processes.process) as vss_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe") AND (Processes.process="*shadow*delete*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") by host | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` ] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime host user play_writes writer_processes vss_cmds
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let PlayWrites = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where FileName endswith ".play" or FileName =~ "ReadMe.txt"
| where FolderPath !startswith "C:\\Windows\\" and FolderPath !startswith "C:\\$Recycle.Bin\\"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize PlayFiles = dcount(FolderPath), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), SampleWriter = any(InitiatingProcessFileName), SampleWriterCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine) by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| where PlayFiles >= 20;
let VssWipe = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("shadows delete","shadowcopy delete","shadowstorage delete","recoveryenabled no","ignoreallfailures","delete catalog","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures")
| summarize VssCmd = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 5) by DeviceId, DeviceName;
PlayWrites
| join kind=inner VssWipe on DeviceId
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, PlayFiles, SampleWriter, SampleWriterCmd, VssCmd
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let PlayWrites = ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where TargetFileName endswith ".play" or TargetFileExtension =~ "play" or TargetFileName =~ "ReadMe.txt"
| where TargetFilePath !startswith "C:\\Windows\\"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| summarize PlayFiles = dcount(TargetFilePath), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), SampleWriter = any(ActingProcessName), SampleWriterCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine) by DvcHostname, ActorUsername
| where PlayFiles >= 20;
let VssWipe = ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("shadows delete","shadowcopy delete","shadowstorage delete","recoveryenabled no","ignoreallfailures","delete catalog")
| summarize VssCmd = make_set(TargetProcessCommandLine, 5) by DvcHostname;
PlayWrites
| join kind=inner VssWipe on DvcHostname
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, PlayFiles, SampleWriter, SampleWriterCmd, VssCmd
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Play Ransomware (Balloonfly) — .play Extension File Write
id: 7c5a4e91-2c0f-4b7d-9b32-9a91f9e5d4a0
status: experimental
description: Detects file creation/rename events with the Play ransomware (.play) extension or per-directory ReadMe.txt ransom note characteristic of Balloonfly intrusions.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-352a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1040/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/28
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.play'
  selection_note:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\ReadMe.txt'
  filter_windows:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\'
      - 'C:\$Recycle.Bin\'
  condition: (selection_ext or selection_note) and not filter_windows
fields:
  - TargetFilename
  - Image
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate developer ReadMe.txt drops (filter by writer process)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1490
  - detection.emerging_threats
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon (@EventID:11 OR @EventID:23) (@TargetFilename:(*.play OR *.PLAY OR *.Play) OR @TargetFilename:(*\\ReadMe.txt OR *\\readme.txt OR *\\README.TXT)) -@TargetFilename:(*\\Windows\\* OR *\\windows\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/(\.play$|\\ReadMe\.txt$)/i
| TargetFileName!=/\\Windows\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(as=playWrites), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| playWrites >= 20
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(vssadmin|wbadmin|wmic|bcdedit)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(shadows?\s+delete|recoveryenabled\s+no|ignoreallfailures|delete\s+catalog)/i | groupBy([aid], function=count(as=vssWipeEvents))}, field=aid, include=[vssWipeEvents])
ucs.rationale: The `.play` file extension and the per-directory `ReadMe.txt` (with that exact casing, no exclamation or HTML variant) are hardcoded encryptor artefacts of the Play/PlayCrypt family — they are not shared by LockBit, BlackCat, Akira or other current major crews. Pairing the extension fan-out (≥20 unique paths per host) with the VSS shadow-copy wipe in the same window separates a real Play detonatio

ucs.title: [LLM] Play (Balloonfly) initial access — OWASSRF / ProxyNotShell Exchange w3wp.exe child-process chain
ucs.description: Hunts the Exchange Server initial-access vector Play has used at scale: post-OWASSRF (CVE-2022-41080 chained with CVE-2022-41082) or ProxyNotShell exploitation, IIS worker `w3wp.exe` hosting an Exchange app pool spawns native discovery/LOLBin children. CrowdStrike (Falcon OverWatch), Microsoft Threat Intelligence and CISA all attribute this exact chain to Play (Balloonfly) — Play was the first crew observed using OWASSRF in the wild (Dec 2022).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as command_lines values(Processes.process_name) as children from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","quser.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "(?i)(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE|IUSR)$") AND match(parent_process, "(?i)(MSExchange|RemotePS|OWA|ECP)") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime host user parent_process children command_lines count
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSExchange","RemotePS","OWA","ECP","FrontEnd","BackEnd")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","quser.exe","hostname.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service","iusr")
| extend SuspiciousCmd = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-EncodedCommand","-enc ","DownloadString","Invoke-Expression","IEX","FromBase64String","-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden"), "powershell-evasion",
    ProcessCommandLine has_any ("certutil -urlcache","certutil -decode","bitsadmin /transfer","bitsadmin /addfile"), "lolbin-download",
    ProcessCommandLine has_any ("whoami /all","net group","net localgroup","nltest /dclist","nltest /domain_trusts"), "discovery",
    "other")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ChildImage = FolderPath, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SuspiciousCmd, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\w3wp.exe"
| where NewProcessName has_any ("\\cmd.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\mshta.exe","\\wscript.exe","\\cscript.exe","\\certutil.exe","\\bitsadmin.exe","\\rundll32.exe","\\regsvr32.exe","\\nltest.exe","\\whoami.exe","\\systeminfo.exe","\\net.exe","\\net1.exe","\\tasklist.exe","\\ipconfig.exe","\\quser.exe","\\hostname.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE","IUSR")
| extend SuspiciousCmd = case(
    CommandLine has_any ("-EncodedCommand","-enc ","DownloadString","IEX","FromBase64String","-w hidden"), "powershell-evasion",
    CommandLine has_any ("certutil -urlcache","bitsadmin /transfer"), "lolbin-download",
    CommandLine has_any ("whoami /all","nltest /dclist","nltest /domain_trusts","net group"), "discovery",
    "other")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, SuspiciousCmd
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Play Ransomware — Exchange w3wp.exe Spawning LOLBin / Discovery Child
id: a91b27c4-5d3e-4f8a-bd61-2c91f6c4a8e3
status: experimental
description: IIS w3wp.exe (hosting an Exchange app pool) spawning native discovery binaries or scripting interpreters — the Play/Balloonfly OWASSRF + ProxyNotShell post-exploitation chain.
references:
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/blog/owassrf-exploit-analysis-and-recommendations/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-352a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/28
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\systeminfo.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: parent and child and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Exchange management scripting in maintenance windows (filter by known admin SIDs)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - detection.emerging_threats
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE OR *\\W3wp.exe) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CertUtil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\WhoAmI.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR IUSR)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^w3wp\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript|certutil|bitsadmin|rundll32|regsvr32|nltest|whoami|systeminfo|net1?|tasklist|ipconfig|quser|hostname)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| UserName!=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE|IUSR)$/i
| regex("(MSExchange|RemotePS|OWA|ECP|FrontEnd|BackEnd)", field=ParentImageFileName, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=[count(as=hits), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([CommandLine], multival=true)])
ucs.rationale: Play/Balloonfly was the first ransomware crew CrowdStrike publicly attributed to OWASSRF (CVE-2022-41080 + CVE-2022-41082) exploitation in December 2022, after Exchange ProxyNotShell URL-rewrite mitigations broke the original chain. Across CrowdStrike, Microsoft and CISA's Play write-ups, the post-exploit foothold is identical: `w3wp.exe` hosting an Exchange app pool drops a webshell and then spaw
